column2: You sounded like a politician. They noticed.
The Pentagon wants to cut your aviation support by 20%. What will you do?
Fight it in the Pentagon
You kept the funding.
They cut it anyway.
Find savings elsewhere
Training budget took the hit.
You brief the President in the Situation Room. He asks for your honest odds of success. What will you do?
Give the real number
He appreciated it. The op was approved.
Round up
It worked. Phew.
It failed. Your optimism is now in the press.
A major newspaper wants a profile on the Unit's commander. The Army says it is up to you. What will you do?
Quiet professionals.
Grant a short interview
Positive coverage.
They quoted you out of context.
Retirement or Star
You are on the shortlist for brigadier general, but it means leaving special operations. What will you do?
Pursue the star
You pinned on a star.
You retired. Fishing awaits.
An inspector general report criticizes your command climate. What will you do?
Accept it and fix it
You made real changes.
Fight the findings
Reversed on appeal.
You were relieved of command.
A British SAS commander proposes a joint op in {country}. Political risks are high. What will you do?
The alliance strengthened. Target eliminated.
A leak embarrassed both governments.
They went alone.
You add a name to the memorial wall. His family asks you to speak at the service. What will you do?
You barely got through it. They thanked you.
Ask his team leader to speak
He knew him best. It was right.
Defense Contractor Offer
A defense contractor offers you a $600K/year job after retirement, wink wink, if you favor their bid now. What will you do?
Report the approach
The IG thanked you. Integrity intact.
Hint you're interested
Nothing traced back. You feel dirty.
Bribery and conflict of interest
The FBI was listening.
A hurricane hits North Carolina. The compound is damaged and your neighbors need help. What will you do?
Volunteer for rescues
You pulled families off rooftops.
Secure your own home
Your family is safe.
Old Teammate Reunion
Your old troop holds a reunion. Stories get exaggerated. Someone tells your story wrong. What will you do?
Correct him
Everyone laughed.
Let it grow
You are now a legend. Factually incorrect, but a legend.
Gold Star Mentor
A Gold Star family asks you to speak at their son's high school about service. What will you do?
The kids were spellbound. Three asked about enlisting.
You could not do it. They understood.
Surprise urinalysis. You took a friend's "sleep gummy" last weekend. What will you do?
Disclose it upfront
It was melatonin. Awkward but fine.
Pee and pray
It had THC in it. NJP.
A charity ruck for fallen operators. 40 miles. Your knees are 40 years old. What will you do?
Ruck it all
You finished. Raised $12,000.
Your knee gave out at mile 28.
Donate and cheer
You handed out water. Still meaningful.
Your personal email was hacked. The attacker may have photos of you in uniform. What will you do?
Report to security
They locked it down.
Changed passwords. Fine.
Your photos showed up on a foreign forum.
Your father had a stroke. You are on alert for a short-notice deployment. What will you do?
Request emergency leave
You were at his bedside. He recovered partially.
Stay on alert
You deployed. He passed while you were gone.
A training exercise requires a disguise. The only thing in the prop room is a mullet wig and a fanny pack. What will you do?
Commit fully
Nobody looked twice at the guy in the mullet.
You were spotted in eight seconds.
You've been assigned to the dining facility. A mountain of greasy trays awaits and the cook is already yelling. How do you handle it?
Scrub like a machine
You finished early. The cook grunted, which counts as praise.
Hide in the dry storage
You napped behind the flour sacks. Nobody noticed.
The cook found you. You now own the grease trap for a week.
Eat the leftover cake
Best sheet cake of your life. Worth it.
Caught with frosting on your face. Extra hours added.
Guard Duty at 0300
It's 0300 on gate guard. Your eyelids weigh a hundred pounds and the coffee ran out an hour ago. What do you do?
Do pushups to stay awake
You stayed alert all shift. Your relief found you sweaty but awake.
Rest your eyes for a sec
You dozed for ten minutes and nobody checked. Lucky.
The sergeant of the guard caught you asleep. NJP. Sleeping on post is no joke.
Chat with {buddy} on the radio
You and {buddy} talked about cars until sunrise.
The OD heard you tying up the net. Chewed out.
Your first real paycheck hit the account. It feels like a fortune. {buddy} says a dealership outside the gate has "military specials." What now?
Buy a new muscle car
You signed for a 24% APR Mustang. It is gorgeous. You are broke.
Open a savings account
You squirreled it away. Future you says thanks.
Blow it all in one weekend
Strip club, steakhouse, tattoo. You don't remember Sunday.
The Car Dealer
A salesman outside the gate says your rank qualifies you for "zero down, easy payments" on a lifted truck. The fine print is tiny. What do you do?
Sign right now
The truck is sick. The 29% interest rate is sicker.
Read the fine print
You spotted three hidden fees and walked out. The salesman cursed in two languages.
Ask the base legal office
JAG told you it was a scam. You bought a used Corolla instead.
PT Test Day
It's PT test day. You partied last night and your stomach is doing backflips. The run starts in five minutes. What's the plan?
Push through it
You puked at the finish line but still maxed the run.
You failed the run by eight seconds. Remedial PT it is.
Go to sick call
The medic gave you a profile and Motrin. Test rescheduled.
The medic saw right through you. Your squad leader is unimpressed.
Chug an energy drink
Heart racing, you set a personal record.
Heart palpitations at mile one. You walked the rest.
Your squad leader needs "a volunteer" to help a colonel's spouse move furniture on Saturday. Everyone stares at you. What do you say?
Hooah, I'll do it
You moved a piano up three flights. The spouse gave you cookies.
Claim a dentist appointment
It worked. Somebody else got the piano.
They checked. You now get the piano AND Sunday detail.
You pointed at {buddy}. {buddy} will remember this.
Surprise room inspection in ten minutes. Your room smells like dip spit and old pizza. What do you do?
Speed clean everything
You shoved everything in your truck. Room passed.
They opened the wall locker. An avalanche of laundry.
Spray a whole can of Febreze
The inspector sniffed, coughed, and moved on.
It smells like a pizza in a meadow. Failed.
You failed. Weekend re-inspection for the whole floor. Everyone hates you.
Drill Sergeant Flashback
You still have nightmares about your basic training instructor screaming about your "Gumby arms." Someone yells nearby and you flinch. How do you cope?
You told the story at chow. Everyone had their own.
Lock up at attention
You snapped to parade rest in a Walmart. A cashier was confused.
Energy Drink Addiction
You're up to six energy drinks a day. Your hands shake when you shave. {buddy} is worried. What do you do?
Quit cold turkey
Three days of headaches, then you felt human again.
You lasted 14 hours before raiding the shoppette.
Make it eight a day
You are vibrating at a frequency only dogs can hear.
Switch to coffee
Black coffee. Much more {branch} anyway.
Field Exercise Rain
Day four of a field exercise. It hasn't stopped raining, your socks are soup, and your poncho has a hole. What do you do?
Change into dry socks
Dry socks. The greatest luxury known to man.
Embrace the suck
Trench foot is starting but your team leader respects the grit.
Sneak to the heated truck
You slept in the cab like royalty.
The platoon sergeant was already sleeping there. Bad move.
Your squad is trading MREs. You got Veggie Omelet, the worst one. {buddy} has Chili Mac. Make a deal?
Offer your jalapeno cheese
Deal. Chili Mac is yours.
{buddy} laughed in your face. Enjoy the omelet.
Eat the omelet
It tasted like a sponge soaked in regret.
Steal the Chili Mac
You swapped bags while {buddy} wasn't looking.
{buddy} caught you. Now nobody trades with you.
Sleeping in Formation
You fell asleep standing up during a long safety brief and started tipping over. The first sergeant is watching. What now?
Pretend you were stretching
Somehow, he bought it.
He did not buy it. Front leaning rest, move.
You admitted it. Extra duty, but he respected the honesty.
There's a party in the barracks. Someone brought a handle of vodka and a fog machine. The staff duty NCO is two floors down. Join in?
Party hard
Legendary night. You woke up in the laundry room.
Staff duty walked in mid-keg-stand. Everyone got NJP.
Stay in and game
You played video games and heard sirens later. Good call.
Go but stay sober
You drove three drunks home. You're a hero.
You've had five beers off base. It's ten minutes back to the gate. A rideshare costs $40. What do you do?
Drive back
You made it back. Your hands were shaking all night.
Gate guards smelled it instantly. DUI, demotion, and a career on life support.
Pay for the ride
Forty bucks well spent.
Call {buddy} for a pickup
{buddy} grumbled but came. You owe them big.
You woke up in {country} with a fresh tattoo of a cartoon frog on your neck. Is that within regs?
Hide it with your collar
Nobody noticed. Yet.
The sergeant major noticed. Paperwork followed.
Painful and expensive. The frog is fading.
Embrace the frog
You named him Gerald. He's part of the team now.
A senior NCO stops you on the sidewalk. Your hands are in your pockets and you're on the phone. What do you do?
Apologize immediately
A short lecture. You survived.
Twenty minutes of yelling. Your phone call ended long ago.
Pretend you didn't hear
You walked away. Somehow, it worked.
He followed you to your unit. Your squad leader got involved.
Your first day at sea and the ship is rolling hard. You're greener than your uniform. What do you do?
Stare at the horizon
It helped. Your stomach found its sea legs.
You puked over the rail. Into the wind. Onto yourself.
Eat saltines
The old salts swear by it. It sort of worked.
Stay in your rack
Your chief dragged you out to swab the deck you puked on.
The ship just docked in {country}. You have 12 hours of liberty and a buddy pair with {buddy}. What's the plan?
Hit the bars
Great night. You learned some local swear words.
Missed liberty curfew. Captain's mast.
See the sights
Ancient ruins and street food. You sent photos home.
Stay aboard and sleep
Twelve hours of glorious rack time.
Flight Line FOD Walk
FOD walk on the flight line at 0600. You spot a tiny bolt near a jet intake. Nobody else saw it. What do you do?
Pick it up and report it
Turns out it came off a tow bar. You may have saved a $30 million engine.
Nothing happened. Probably.
An engine ate the bolt. The investigation traced it to your lane.
Your recruiter promised you'd be "basically a pilot." You're cleaning latrines. What do you do?
Call the recruiter
Voicemail full. Of course.
Accept the grind
Everyone starts somewhere. Your latrines sparkle.
Study for a better job
You started prepping to reclassify. Smart.
Senior members of your unit say new guys have to "earn their spot" with a humiliating ritual tonight. What do you do?
Degrading, but it's over. They treat you like one of them now.
It got out of hand. You ended up at the clinic.
Report it to the IG
An investigation was opened. Some people won't talk to you now.
Refuse quietly
They called you soft but left you alone.
Your Kevlar is missing from your locker. Hand receipt check is tomorrow and it costs $500. What do you do?
Report it missing
Statement of charges. Expensive lesson.
Acquire someone else's
Problem solved. Circle of life.
It had a name written inside. You got NJP for larceny.
Buy one at the surplus store
Close enough. Nobody checked serials.
You've been sneaking a fellow junior enlisted from another company into your room. The rules say no overnight guests. Keep it up?
Keep sneaking
Love wins. Staff duty never caught on.
Caught at 0500. Extra duty for both of you.
Move off base together
You moved out. Romantic, and expensive.
End it
You called it off. Awkward at the chow hall now.
Dear John Letter
Mail call. Your high school sweetheart sent a letter. It starts with "I need to tell you something..." What do you do?
They're marrying your cousin. You stared at the wall for hours.
Burn it unread
Ignorance is bliss. Mostly.
It was bad news. {buddy} bought you a pizza and roasted your ex.
Qualification day at the range. You're borderline and the wind is gusting. What's your approach?
Breathe and focus
You shot expert. Badge on the chest.
You missed qualifying by one. Back to the range.
Ask a coach for tips
Adjusted your zero. Qualified sharpshooter.
Spray and pray
The range officer just said "No."
Your team leader hands you $20 and says, "Get me a pack of smokes, a dip, and a Rip It. Keep the change." There's no change. Go?
Cover the difference
You paid the rest. Team leader owes you one.
Point out the math
He gave you another five and a dirty look.
You're short on rent for your off-base apartment. A payday lender near the gate offers instant cash at "low" rates. What do you do?
Take the loan
You paid rent. The 300% APR will haunt you.
Go to the relief society
Interest-free loan from military relief. Lifesaver.
Sell your PlayStation
Rent paid. Boredom achieved.
Stray Dog on Base
A scrawny stray dog keeps following your squad around base. Pets are banned in the barracks. What do you do?
Adopt it secretly
You named it Private Biscuit. Morale is through the roof.
Animal control took Biscuit. Paperwork for you.
Biscuit found a family. You visit sometimes.
Feed it MREs
The dog likes the jalapeno cheese more than you do.
Guard Mount Lie
{buddy} skipped their guard shift and asks you to tell the sergeant they were there. What do you say?
The sergeant believed you. {buddy} owes you forever.
Caught lying on an official statement. You both got NJP.
You told the truth. {buddy} stopped talking to you.
Social Media Leak
You took a cool selfie in front of a classified screen and almost hit "post." What do you do?
Post it anyway
It got 40 likes and nobody noticed. Dumb luck.
mishandling classified information
Security found it within an hour. Court-martial for mishandling classified info.
You deleted it and sweated for a week.
Crop it and post
Cropped clean. Good selfie.
A reflection in your sunglasses showed the screen. NJP.
CBRN training. You're in the gas chamber and the instructor tells you to take off your mask and recite your social. What do you do?
Do it calmly
Snot everywhere, but you stayed calm. Respect earned.
Panic and run
You bolted. The instructors made you go back in.
Twelve miles into a ruck march, your heel feels like it's on fire. You're near the back. What do you do?
Keep marching
You finished. Your sock is stuck to your foot with blood.
Your foot gave out. You rode in the sag wagon.
Stop and moleskin it
Thirty seconds of moleskin. You finished strong.
Fall out
The sag wagon of shame.
A guy in the barracks offers you synthetic weed and swears "it doesn't show up on a piss test." What do you do?
You felt weird for a day. Never again.
Random urinalysis caught it. You're being separated.
Two weeks later he got caught. Good call.
CID raided his room. Some people call you a snitch.
You just saluted a warrant officer's cousin who's wearing civilian clothes. Then you failed to salute an actual officer. What now?
Run after the officer
You caught up and saluted. The officer laughed.
Pretend nothing happened
Nobody cared.
The officer chewed you out in front of the PX.
You set your rifle down for one second in the field and now it's gone. The whole battalion is about to halt. What do you do?
Report it immediately
Your sergeant found it 30 feet away. You'll carry a broomstick for a month.
Search frantically alone
Found it under a bush. Nobody knows.
You waited too long. The whole battalion searched. NJP.
Sick Call Ranger
Your knee hurts a little. {buddy} says go to sick call to skip the ruck march. Do it?
You got a light-duty profile. Easy week.
Medic said walk it off. Now they call you "Sick Call Ranger."
Ruck anyway
You finished. Knee is angry, but you earned respect.
Coast Guard Rescue Swim
A fishing boat capsized in rough seas. Your crew is first on scene and a man is drowning 30 meters out. What do you do?
Throw a ring buoy
Perfect throw. You hauled him in.
The wind carried it off. A helicopter got him, barely.
Jump in after him
You pulled him out against the swell. Commendation incoming.
drowned during a rescue
The surf hammered you. You barely made it back.
Tough Barracks Room
Your new roommate never showers, plays drums at 2 AM, and eats your food. What do you do?
Talk to him
He agreed to shower. Small victories.
He shrugged and started drumming again.
Tell your squad leader
He got moved. Peace at last.
Blanket party
He got the message. He showers now.
He reported it. You got NJP for assault.
The unit ball is this weekend. You have no date and the grog bowl looks suspicious. What do you do?
Go and drink the grog
It contained Tabasco, rum, and a boot. You loved it.
Bring {buddy} as a "date"
You two danced to Cotton Eye Joe. Legendary.
Your first sergeant noticed. Mandatory fun is mandatory.
Re-Up Bonus Pitch
The career counselor waves a $20,000 re-enlistment bonus at you. Your contract ends in eight months. Sign?
You re-upped. Time to buy a boat you don't need.
Think it over
You're weighing the GI Bill against the cash.
Laugh and walk away
Counting days. Civilian life is calling.
You woke up at 0640. Formation was at 0630. Your phone shows 17 missed calls. What do you do?
Sprint to formation
You showed up with toothpaste on your face. Counseling statement.
Claim food poisoning
They bought it and sent you to sick call.
Your squad leader saw your bar tab from last night on Instagram.
You're driving a truck in a convoy at night on blackout drive. The NVGs are fogging up and the road is narrow. What's your move?
Slow down
You kept your interval. The convoy arrived safe.
You fell behind and got lost for 20 minutes.
Keep pace no matter what
Smooth driving. Your truck commander was impressed.
You rolled into a ditch. Truck on its side, bruised ribs.
Barracks Fire Alarm
Someone burned popcorn and the barracks fire alarm is going off at 0200. Everyone has to stand outside in the cold. You know who did it. Say?
Rat them out
The microwave was confiscated from the whole floor.
You froze for an hour. Solidarity.
Base Gym Rat
The gym on base is free and open 24/7. {buddy} wants to start a bulking program together. In?
Lift every day
Six weeks later, your sleeves are tight.
Try supplements
Gains are real.
Sketchy pre-workout gave you heart palpitations.
Nah, video games
You maxed a different kind of level.
Money keeps disappearing from rooms. You catch a guy from your squad walking out of a neighbor's room with a wallet. What do you do?
He returned it and confessed to the chain of command.
He swung at you and ran.
Report to the NCO
He was caught and kicked out.
Your wallet went missing next.
{rank} {name}, your platoon sergeant is screaming at you inches from your face because your boots aren't shined. How do you react?
Stare straight ahead
You let it wash over you. It ended eventually.
Mistake. Push-ups until your arms gave up.
Say "Roger, Sergeant"
Textbook response. He walked off satisfied.
One of your junior soldiers has been late three times this week and smells like booze. He looks exhausted. How do you handle it?
Counsel him privately
He admitted his marriage is falling apart. You got him to chaplain support.
Smoke him in front of everyone
He's sore and humiliated. The real problem remains.
Send him to the ASAP program
Substance abuse counseling. He thanked you a year later.
Your evaluation is due and your rater wrote "solid performer." In promotion-speak, that's a death sentence. What do you do?
Push back politely
You got "Most Qualified" with strong bullets.
Your rater got defensive. Eval unchanged.
Promotion just got a lot harder.
Write your own bullets
Your rater copied them word for word.
You're in front of the promotion board. The sergeant major asks you to recite the NCO Creed. Your mind goes blank. What do you do?
Take a breath and go
You nailed it. Selected for promotion.
You stumbled on the second paragraph. Not selected this time.
Admit you blanked
They appreciated the honesty and your other answers carried you.
Not this time.
Ruck March Leadership
You're leading a 12-mile ruck. One of your soldiers is falling way behind and crying. How do you handle it?
Carry part of his load
You took his radio. The whole squad finished together.
Yell motivation at him
He found a second wind.
He collapsed. Heat casualty. Investigation pending.
Drop him to the sag wagon
He's safe, but squad pride took a hit.
It's 0300. Off-post police call: one of your soldiers was arrested for fighting outside a club. What do you do?
Go pick him up
You bailed him out and got the story. He was defending a friend.
Let him sit till morning
A night in jail taught him something.
Ignore your phone
The first sergeant had to go. He was not pleased with you.
Suicide Warning Signs
A young soldier has been giving away his gear and says "it won't matter soon." What do you do?
Ask him directly
You asked. He admitted it. You walked him to behavioral health. He's alive.
Tell the chain of command
He was escorted to help. You check on him daily.
Assume he's joking
He was okay. You still feel uneasy.
He took his own life two days later. You will carry this forever.
You're staff duty NCO and hear music and laughter coming from a room after quiet hours. Smells like weed. What do you do?
Knock and enter
Three soldiers with a vape full of THC. You did your job.
Turn down the music and leave
You avoided the drama. For now.
Call the MPs
They hauled them off. The commander is pleased.
Mentoring a Rookie
A new private with a lot of potential asks you how to make sergeant fast. What advice do you give?
Study, PT, volunteer
Two years later, he pinned sergeant and thanked you.
Tell him to kiss up
He became a brown-noser. Yikes.
Don't get caught.
He laughed. Classic NCO wisdom.
Sergeant's Time Training
You have to teach a class to your squad on land navigation. Half of them are falling asleep. What do you do?
Take them outside
Hands-on with a real map. Everyone learned something.
Read the PowerPoint
Even you fell asleep.
Make it a competition
Winners got a day off. Suddenly everyone loves land nav.
Inventory is due. You're missing two night vision devices worth $8,000 each. Someone suggests "adjusting" the paperwork. What do you do?
Report it honestly
Investigation found them in another unit's connex. Close call.
Fudge the numbers
Nobody checked. You sleep badly.
falsifying official records
An audit caught it. Court-martial for false official records.
One of your soldiers tells you she's pregnant and scared to tell the chain of command. What do you do?
Support her
Gossip about it
Word got around. She filed an EO complaint.
Your new lieutenant insists the platoon walk the wrong direction on a land nav exercise. He's confident. You know he's wrong. What do you do?
Correct him privately
He listened. Crisis averted. He trusts you now.
Let him fail
Three hours lost. He learned. So did the company commander.
Correct him in public
The platoon loved it. He didn't.
You're at the NCO academy. You could aim for the Commandant's List but it means no sleep. Worth it?
Commandant's List. Your career just accelerated.
You burned out and finished middle of the pack.
Just pass
Graduated. You slept eight hours a night.
One of your married soldiers shows up with scratches on his face. He says "it's nothing." What do you do?
Check in with him
He opened up. You connected him and his spouse with the family advocacy program.
Mind your business
Things got worse. MPs got involved two weeks later.
Finance shorted one of your soldiers $1,500 and he can't pay rent. Finance says "two to three pay periods." What do you do?
Storm the finance office
You camped there until it got fixed. Hero to your soldier.
The finance clerk took your yelling personally. Even slower now.
Loan him money
He paid you back. You built serious loyalty.
Tell him to suck it up
He got evicted. Morale in the squad dropped.
You've developed feelings for a private in your own platoon. They seem to feel the same. What do you do?
Start dating secretly
Nobody found out. You're walking a razor's edge.
Someone saw you holding hands. Fraternization. Busted down a rank.
Request a transfer
You moved units. Now it's legal. Mostly.
The right call. It still stings.
You're range safety. A private turns around with a loaded weapon pointing down the firing line. What do you do?
Everyone froze. You redirected the barrel. Nobody died today.
You took him down safely. Weapon pointed downrange.
A round went off into the dirt and grazed your leg.
Prepping a Board
Your best specialist has the soldier of the quarter board tomorrow. He's nervous. Do you help?
Drill him all night
He won. Your squad has bragging rights.
Tell him to wing it
He won anyway. Natural talent.
He bombed. The other squad leader smirked.
Monday morning. Your whole squad is visibly hungover after a three-day weekend. PT is about to start. What do you do?
Smoke check them
Ninety minutes of burpees. Lesson learned.
Easy run, hydration
They appreciated the mercy. Loyalty earned.
The Chief's Coffee
Aboard ship, you discover a junior sailor has been brewing the chief's mess coffee with week-old grounds. The chiefs are furious. Cover for him?
The chiefs hazed you a bit. Your sailor will die for you now.
Throw him under the bus
He scrubbed the coffee urn with a toothbrush.
You're inspecting dress uniforms. One soldier has his ribbons upside down and a missing badge. Inspection is in an hour. What do you do?
Fix it with him
Ten minutes with a ruler. Passed.
He failed. Squad looks bad.
Quarters Housing Mold
Your family's base housing has black mold in the bathroom. Your kid has been coughing. Privatized housing says it's "a cosmetic issue." What do you do?
Escalate to the garrison
They moved you to a new unit within a week.
They painted over it. Your kid still coughs.
Move off post
Expensive, but you breathe easier.
Go to the local news
The story aired. Repairs started the next day.
The garrison commander was not happy with you.
Before a field exercise, you find a private's ruck is stuffed with pillows to look full. What do you do?
Make him repack it
Proper load. He grumbled.
Make him carry a sandbag too
He won't try that again.
Your squad thinks you're cool. The first sergeant doesn't.
Sexual Harassment Report
A soldier tells you another NCO has been sending her inappropriate messages. The NCO is your friend. What do you do?
An investigation opened. Doing the right thing cost you a friendship.
Talk to your friend first
He denied it and deleted everything.
One of your soldiers failed tape test again. One more and he's chaptered out. He really wants to stay. What do you do?
Train with him daily
He dropped 20 pounds and passed.
Process the separation
Rules are rules. He went home.
Sergeant Major's Eye
The command sergeant major spotted your soldiers walking on the grass. He wants to see you in his office. What do you say?
Take responsibility
He respected that. Mostly.
Blame the soldiers
Who's their leader, Sergeant? Ouch.
Pick Up Rank
You made the cut-off score for promotion. The pinning ceremony is Friday and your family wants to come. Hold a party?
Host a barbecue
Promotion pinned. Brisket smoked. Life is good.
Pinned on the motor pool floor. Humble.
Flight Line Accident
Your crew is rushing an aircraft for launch. A junior airman skipped a torque check to save time. Launch is in 10 minutes. What do you do?
Delay the launch
You found a loose panel. Maintenance officer quietly thanked you.
It flew fine.
A panel tore off in flight. Safety investigation names you.
Your unit got orders. You deploy to {country} in 60 days. Your spouse just found out. How do you break it?
Plan a nice dinner
Tears, but you made a plan together.
Blurt it out
Not your finest moment. It led to a fight.
Volunteer to stay back
You got rear detachment. Your spouse is relieved.
Denied. And your first sergeant thinks you're soft.
Squad PT Champion
The battalion is holding a PT competition. Your squad can win a four-day pass. What's your strategy?
Train them hard
Your squad won. Four-day weekend!
Second place. No pass.
Recruit the fittest guy
He carried you to victory.
He pulled a hamstring on day one.
Dead Animal in HVAC
Your shop smells like death. A raccoon died in the ventilation system. Maintenance says six weeks. What do you do?
Crawl in yourself
You removed it. You will never smell normal again.
Order the junior troops to do it
Done. A private threw up twice.
Work outside
Office under a tree. Peaceful.
Gold Star Family
You're detailed as a casualty notification NCO. You have to knock on a family's door to tell them their son died. How do you prepare?
Rehearse with the chaplain
You did it with dignity. You cried in the car afterward.
Just go
The mother screamed. You will hear it forever.
Old School vs New School
